room-bed.description: Quiet Victorian sitting room: fireplace crackle prominent, faint mantel clock tick. Generated in ElevenLabs seamless-loop mode; loop the whole file.

street-bed.description: Distant London night street heard from indoors: low wind, faint far carriage passes. Seamless-loop mode; loop the whole file. ~28 dB peak headroom if it needs boosting.

page-turn.description: Single heavy paper page turn, clean decay to silence by ~1.2 s.

paper-rustle.description: Letter unfold / paper handling, clean tail.

hoofbeats.description: Horse + carriage approaching on cobblestones, slows and stops (quiet by ~7.5 s). Peaks at full scale - keep volume <= 0.7 so it reads as outside the window.

door-knock.description: Firm triple knock on heavy wooden door, starts immediately, silent tail.

click-soft.description: Single soft paper tap for text advance. Already subtle; 0.4-0.6 volume keeps it diegetic.

step.description: Two slow heavy boot footsteps climbing wooden stairs, wood creak under each step (the colossus on the stair, i-13). Keep <=0.7 so it reads as beyond the room door; peak -2.4 dBFS is hot.

reveal.description: Soft airy non-musical shimmer of light passing through paper - the press-and-hold watermark payoff. Keep subtle (0.4-0.5); fire as the hold resolves, not on press.

book.description: Heavy book pulled from a wooden shelf then opened (gazetteer i-08/gaz1 + index lookup gate). Peak -0.6 dBFS is near full scale - do not boost, cap <=0.7.

mask-drop.description: Small hard lacquered object hitting a wooden floor, single short clatter - the mask hurled down at the unmask gate (iamking). Starts immediately, silent tail by ~0.48 s.
